gloss: to push aside; to shove out of the way

definitions.gloss: to push aside; to shove out of the way
definitions.explanation: To physically move someone or something out of one's path by pushing. A compound of 押す (to push) + のける (to move aside).
To disregard or overcome opposition, objections, or rivals in order to proceed. Used figuratively for pushing past obstacles.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}を{押|お}しのけて{前|まえ}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: I pushed people aside and moved to the front.

examples.japanese: {邪魔|じゃま}な{荷物|にもつ}を{押|お}しのけて{通路|つうろ}を{確保|かくほ}した。
examples.english: I pushed the obstructing luggage aside to clear the aisle.

examples.japanese: {満員|まんいん}の{電車|でんしゃ}で{人|ひと}を{押|お}しのけるのはやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish people would stop shoving others aside on packed trains.

examples.japanese: {反対|はんたい}{意見|いけん}を{押|お}しのけて{計画|けいかく}を{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: They pushed aside the opposing views and proceeded with the plan.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{強豪|きょうごう}チームを{押|お}しのけて{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
examples.english: She beat out the powerhouse teams and won the championship.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}を{押|お}しのけて{目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}するには、{強|つよ}い{意志|いし}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To overcome difficulties and achieve your goal, you need a strong will.

notes:
USAGE:
{押|お}しのける is an ichidan verb. It can take a direct object marked with を: {人|ひと}を{押|お}しのける (push a person aside).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}を{押|お}しのける (push people aside)
- {周|まわ}りを{押|お}しのける (push one's way through)
- ライバルを{押|お}しのける (beat out rivals)
- {反対|はんたい}を{押|お}しのける (override opposition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{押|お}しのける implies forceful removal from one's path. {押|お}し{退|の}ける is an alternate kanji spelling with the same meaning. {突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす means "to shove away" with more violent force.
